summary: pip can install ansible-core's devel branch straight from a GitHub tarball URL; swap devel for another branch or tag to get older, alpha, beta or RC versions.
questions: How do I pip install ansible-core from GitHub?
How do I install a release candidate of ansible-core?

answer_card.title: Install devel from GitHub with pip
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
python3 -m pip install --user https://github.com/ansible/ansible/archive/devel.tar.gz
```
Replace `devel` with any branch or tag to get older versions, alphas, betas or release candidates.
